classification: design-data-only; not canonical executable test input
baseline: Official Node v22.15.0 documentation, not a new native oracle capture
expectationMeaning: Normative proposed virtual-profile outcomes, not observed results or full Node byte parity. null means the adjacent qualifier intentionally leaves that field unsettled.

defaults.provider: future independently qualified NP1 provider; none selected or executed
defaults.filesystem: controlled authority-limited VFS, parent /work exists, no ambient filesystem
defaults.stateAfter: parent cwd/env unchanged; no namespace mutation except explicitly listed; all cooperative invocation resources retired before settlement
defaults.shellRedirections: none; Shell redirection effects are outside entry-preflight no-effects assertions
defaults.argvEncoding: literal argv array; source strings are never executed by this artifact

cases.name: actual inline evaluation
assertions: Output depends on evaluated source, not a canned command handler

cases.name: primitive print and literal eval arguments
cases.qualification: Virtual execPath and argv convention are proposed, not freshly oracle-verified

cases.name: undefined is a print value rather than omitted output
assertions: Do not reuse safejs print omission for undefined

cases.name: print statement list rejected during admission

expected.stderrUtf8: node: ERR_VNODE_UNSUPPORTED: print requires one expression

assertions: No console host call occurs; a full Node eval-completion claim is not made

cases.name: VFS script argv, exit status and parent isolation
stdin-as-source is consumed once
assertions: No second stdin acquisition or duplicated source-as-data bytes

cases.name: stdin data ownership and UTF8 split decoding
assertions: Retained bytes copied before producer reuse/finalization
stdinIsDefault does not decide whether bytes exist

cases.name: module-mode promise fs JSON editing
argv: import fs from 'node:fs/promises'; const data=JSON.parse(await fs.readFile('config.json','utf8')); data.count+=1; await fs.writeFile('config.json',JSON.stringify(data)); console.log(data.count);
assertions: No host fs import; actual supplied VFS gets the mutation

cases.name: sync VFS creation and exclusive collision
assertions: Exclusive VFS publication is real, not stat-then-write
Sync calls never expose a Promise

cases.name: sync continuation blocks guest jobs while host read is held
cases.control: Hold the VFS read after admission, inspect pending state, then release its bytes
cases.qualification: Required virtual sync/job ordering; not currently established by SafeJS

cases.name: JSON first-load timing, alias identity and cache retention
argv: const fs=require('fs'); fs.writeFileSync('c.json','{"v":1}'); const first=require('./c.json'); first.v=2; fs.writeFileSync('c.json','{"v":3}'); const second=require('././c.json'); console.log(first===second); console.log(second.v);
assertions: No eager JSON preload before the earlier write
Cache is guest-native, not a fresh host-value copy

cases.name: failed JSON module load does not poison the cache
cases.qualification: NP1 preserves VFS error codes; this is not a claim of Node MODULE_NOT_FOUND diagnostic parity

cases.name: pure POSIX paths use virtual cwd
assertions: Zero filesystem or host cwd calls for lexical path operations

cases.name: exported env only and inert loader environment
read-only provider error remains meaningful
cases.filesystem: controlled read-only VFS; writeText call rejects FsError EROFS with path /work/out
assertions: Do not fabricate writable success or coerce failure to ENOENT

cases.name: builtin aliases preserve guest identity
assertions: Repeated host-object wrapping cannot substitute for one guest module object

cases.name: main source cannot escape VFS authority
cases.filesystem: trusted confined adapter refuses a symlink from /work/link to outside its configured namespace before any content read
cases.unsettled: Provider-specific typed permission error/message retained; no invented universal errno or diagnostic bytes

cases.name: malformed JSON causes a real guest failure
assertions: Parse failure does not become null/empty data or a success stub

cases.name: unsupported fs overload refuses before data acquisition
assertions: Omitted encoding is not silently treated as UTF8
URL/buffer paths and unsupported options need equivalent pre-operation rejection

cases.name: literal forbidden builtin rejected in complete-entry preflight
assertions: No host require/fs/process/eval fallback

cases.name: computed module refusal does not erase earlier effects
assertions: No global no-effects or rollback promise for runtime refusal
Classifier does not run guest code to constant-fold this expression

cases.name: local executable module is not confused with entry loading
assertions: No package/index/extension probing or native addon loading

cases.name: dynamic import and code-generation syntax denied before entry effects
cases.qualification: Sibling inputs remain individually unexecuted admission checks, not additional passed identities; their feature diagnostics differ

cases.name: ambiguous js entry does not ignore package semantics
assertions: Search only authorized ancestors; unavailable ancestor authority is refusal, not no-package proof

cases.name: native flags refused before reading source
cases.qualification: Flags after an eval selector may be guest args; the conflicting-mode control places --input-type=module before -p. Sibling diagnostic bytes are not settled here. No Node version string may be fabricated.

cases.name: unavailable or insufficient provider is not a working node
cases.provider: absent, or frozen SafeJsRuntime lacking qualified NP1 facilities

expected.stderrUtf8: node: ERR_VNODE_PROVIDER: qualified NP1 provider required

assertions: No install/private import/vendor/native/eval fallback

cases.name: caller reason identity and held cooperative acquisition
cases.control: Hold admitted read and cleanup, abort root caller with a particular object carrying code ENOENT, then release cooperative cleanup

expected.afterRelease: all owned work retired before public rejection

cases.unsettled: Raw public rejection is not a numeric command status; primitive/undefined/falsy reason controls require separate future runs
assertions: errno-shaped cancellation is not swallowed as missing file
No post-abort guest statement or reacquisition

cases.name: escaping host failure outranks later local cancellation
cases.control: Sink fails with raw object FAILURE, then local deadline aborts before final selection; a separate ordered control additionally aborts the root caller with CALLER

expected.outcome: FAILURE by identity without caller abort; CALLER by identity with caller abort

cases.unsettled: These are ordered raw rejection outcomes, not errors reconstructed from result status
assertions: Record origin independently of reason equality
Shared identical reason objects across different origins must not determine precedence

cases.name: register-before-acquisition and idempotent root cleanup barrier
cases.control: Instrument provider create/prepare, stdout operation creation and stdin admission; hold one registered cleanup; overlap command finally and Shell.dispose
assertions: Cleanup registered synchronously before resource creation
Provider close, nested scopes and admitted work share one retirement promise
Controlled normal completion status applies only when dispose adds no caller cancellation

cases.name: destination closure does not cancel sibling resources
argv: import fs from 'node:fs/promises'; const pending=fs.writeFile('out','kept'); process.stdout.write('closed'); await pending;
cases.control: Admit and hold file write and independent stderr work, then close enrolled stdout; release all owned resources
cases.unsettled: Outer Shell early-pipe/pipefail selection and independent stderr payload determine final bytes/status; no universal 0 or 141 claim
assertions: The admitted file write is not undone
Destination close drains its own scope and does not cancel shared fs

cases.name: unawaited promise failure cannot disappear after guest return
cases.control: Hold cooperative write after guest top-level completion, then reject with FsError EROFS /work/out
cases.unsettled: Exact unhandled-guest diagnostic formatting is not yet settled; raw failure must remain observed and cooperative resources must retire

cases.name: source and parse admission caps precede guest effects

inputData.remainder: ASCII spaces to declared byte count

assertions: No parser stack overflow or unlimited work hidden by byte cap
Each sibling needs its own limit-specific diagnostic and future execution

cases.name: guest step and call-depth limits cannot reset
requiredSiblingInputs: Promise jobs consuming one aggregate step allowance
Repeated JSON requires cannot reset steps or aggregate read allowance
assertions: Budget spans callbacks/continuations/modules
No elapsed-time correctness oracle; callback/depth controls need individual limit assertions

cases.name: byte output cap refuses an entire write before publication
cases.qualification: UTF8 makes the second write4 bytes. Remaining combined output2 cannot admit a full limit diagnostic, so diagnostic output is omitted, not budget-exempt.
assertions: No partial second write or UTF16 byte-count confusion
VFS write caps likewise check before invoking a mutator

cases.name: concurrent invocation caches, state and resource ownership are disjoint
cases.control: Run two future NP1 invocations with distinct VFS instances/cwd/env but identical module paths; hold and locally abort the first, complete the second
cases.unsettled: First invocation's held boundary determines whether earlier bytes were already written; it cannot change second's outcome

cases.name: host request validation and insufficient-provider containment
cases.control: An intentionally nonconforming provider sends a request with own accessor path or an extra field; a separate controlled request is a valid cross-realm own-data record

expected.validCrossRealmRequest: accepted by structural validation under the same grants

cases.unsettled: Invalid provider request is an escaping contract failure, not guest success or a fixed numeric Shell status; diagnostic wording unbound
assertions: No coercion/prototype-identity admission
Uncooperative opaque work is observed but cannot be claimed forcibly retired
Trusted host JS is not sandboxed by these checks
